cli_usage:
Mak3P audio-to-MP3 converter

Usage:
  Mak3P-cli inspect FILE [options]
  Mak3P-cli convert FILE [options]
  Mak3P-cli batch FILE... [options]

Options:
  --bitrate 128|160|192|224|256|320
  --channels auto|stereo|mono
  --output-dir DIRECTORY
  --folder-import
  --include-mp3
  --force-upsampling
  --workers auto|0|1..64
  --log
  --config FILE
  --save-settings
  --ffmpeg EXECUTABLE
  --ffprobe EXECUTABLE

Batch conversion supports Ctrl+C cancellation.
